verdict.rationale: Aider's core documented workflow is exactly this: describe a change in natural language, it edits multiple files added to chat (or auto-detects which files to edit), commits changes, and community reports confirm it works well across real codebases including multi-file navigation/modification. Missing for 10: no rigorous independent benchmark of multi-file bug-fix accuracy beyond anecdotal HN reports, and community notes occasional errors/laziness with certain models.
